content: Older adults with diabetes should undergo regular evaluations to determine their risk of hypoglycemia. This process involves assessing whether they are missing doses of their medications or taking them incorrectly. Additionally, it is important to evaluate their ability to recognize the symptoms of hypoglycemia. Tools such as the Diabetes Care Profile and validated risk calculators can provide valuable assistance in this assessment. It is also critical to note that intensive diabetes management strategies, particularly those aimed at achieving tight glucose control, may elevate the risk of hypoglycemia in this population.
